Daily Devotional

February 18

6 Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things. 7 Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap. - Gal 6:6-7 (KJV)

This verse is saying that you need to give (communicate) money to those that teach you God’s Word.  If you are taught correctly, the Word of God, then you need to give tithes and offerings to whoever is teaching you (1 Timothy 5:18).  Many people are in churches that are dead, and are not being taught the true Word of God, and yet they give their tithes to that church – that is wrong.  You need to always give where you are fed the true Word (2 Corinthians 9:7), not where you are begged or where you attend, if they are not teaching God’s Word correctly.  You do not buy groceries at one store then go to another store to pay for them.  You need to always pay where you are being fed.

This principal is taught throughout the bible, and is so very true, that you will reap what you sow, and only what you sow (2 Corinthians 9:6).  Think about the fact that if you plant wheat seed in your field, when you are wanting corn to grow, it will not happen.  If you want corn to grow, you have to plant corn seeds.  The same facts work in the Kingdom of God, as you will not get to reap, except what you sow.  If you want financial gains, then you must give finances to the Lord’s work.  If you want people to give to you, then you must give to people in need.  God will not be mocked, and you will reap what you sow.  If you sow strife and evil, then you will reap the same (James 3:16).  This truth is applicable to everything in life, and it is very important that you realize these facts.  Sow what you want, and speak what you want out of your mouth, with faith, and that is what you will reap (Matthew 17:20).  Think, say, and give the things you want to receive, and if you have faith, and no unbelief, it will come to pass.  Praise God for giving us the rules of His Kingdom!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
